title: Reclassify the three shipped Claude Code route Agent Notes as implemented
task:
Problem: three Agent Notes about this route still live under .agents/notes/proposed/architecture/ with `Status: proposed` although what they propose ships. `2026-09-06-llm-claude-code.md` proposes the route itself: packages/llm/llm-claude-code exists, with the Loader-booted packages/llm/llm-claude-code/tests/loader-composition.e2e.ts and the opt-in tests/real-product.e2e.ts its acceptance names. `2026-09-07-claude-code-route-native-tools.md` proposes the in-process MCP server that offers the harness tools: `MCP_TOOL_PREFIX` is `mcp__dsh__` at packages/llm/llm-claude-code/src/tools.ts:22 and the server is mounted at packages/llm/llm-claude-code/src/adapter.ts:197. `2026-09-08-claude-code-route-session-continuity.md` proposes `sessionContinuity` and `resumableSessionLimit`: both are Config fields in packages/llm/llm-claude-code/src/config.ts (`DEFAULT_RESUMABLE_SESSION_LIMIT` at :58), documented at packages/llm/llm-claude-code/README.md:36 and :50 and tested in tests/continuity.spec.ts. The notes README lifecycle rule (.agents/notes/README.md, 'Lifecycle') places a shipped decision under implemented/, kept current with what shipped, and this package's README still links the continuity note as a proposal at packages/llm/llm-claude-code/README.md:126.

Required, per note: check every bullet of its '## Acceptance criteria' section against the tree; move the complete triplet (`.md`, `.zh.md`, `.i18n.yaml`) with `git mv` to .agents/notes/implemented/architecture/ keeping the filename; set line 3 to `Status: implemented` in both languages; rewrite future-tense proposal sentences minimally into present-tense facts where the shipped code differs (facts only, never the decision, per .agents/notes/implemented/AGENTS.md); fix relative links inside the moved notes (a link to a note that stays proposed, such as `2026-09-05-read-barrier.md`, becomes `../../proposed/architecture/...`) and links to the moved notes from other files (packages/llm/llm-claude-code/README.md:126 with its Chinese counterpart, plus whatever `grep -rn <filename> packages docs .agents` finds); re-record every touched pair with `pnpm run verify-translation-pairing --write <pair paths>`.

Constraints: if one note's acceptance criteria are not all met, leave that note in place and name the failing bullet in your report; no code changes.
